scope: Production readiness probes and remediation verification

results.remediation: Authoritative validate_refund() service gate checks return timestamp against delivery date and 30-day window independently of agent routing.

Recovery logic in RefundService._recover() safely retries using the original idempotency key and request payload for CLAIMED/SENDING/PROCESSING states when provider returns TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND with safe_to_resend=true.

Provider decline marks the operation DECLINED and the proposal DECLINED. approval_service.create_proposal() recognizes terminal proposals and creates a fresh proposal with a new ID requiring fresh approval.
validate_refund() enforces status IN ('CAPTURED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED') and database CheckConstraint payment_valid_status enforces status invariants.
